svg.title: Renan Bazinin: Full-stack developer · B.Sc. Computer Science (MTA)
svg.desc: Animated header. A terminal runs Conway's Game of Life seeded with the name Renan Bazinin: the name forms in pixels, holds, then evolves under the B3/S23 rules before forming again. Gliders cross the sky above a small pixel street with a string of lanterns.
